title: SAP Analyst

description: Company Profile: Lennox (NYSE: LII) Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. Job Description: Job Description – Analyst – IT Risk and Compliance Key Responsibilities Assists with planning and execution of information technology SOX assessments by understanding organizational objectives, processes, policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements. Supports risk and control assessments by identifying potential areas of non-compliance, process weaknesses, control gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Performs compliance testing under established procedures and guidance, including documenting testing performed, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence. Tests IT General Controls (ITGCs) covering logical access, change management, computer operations, and system development/change lifecycle. Performs SAP ITGC/SOX control testing , particularly across logical access, privileged access, change management, and IT operations. Supports testing of IT Automated Controls (ITACs) and application controls supporting key business processes such as Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting. Prepares clear and complete compliance assessment workpapers, testing documentation, and supporting evidence in accordance with established standards. Participates in walkthroughs with business and IT stakeholders to understand applications, infrastructure, business processes, risks, and controls. Documents processes, risks, and controls through narratives, flowcharts, control matrices, and other supporting documentation. Supports evaluation of new or changed processes, systems, and controls to determine their potential impact on the SOX compliance program . Assists in identifying control deficiencies and supporting root-cause analysis and remediation activities. Tracks and follows up on IT audit and compliance findings to ensure remediation activities are completed within agreed timelines. Supports external and internal auditors by coordinating documentation, evidence, walkthroughs, and other information requests. Communicates testing progress, observations, and identified issues to the Internal Audit Team and relevant stakeholders. Obtains, analyzes, and evaluates technical and business documentation, reports, system-generated data, process flows, and supporting evidence. Maintains confidentiality of organizational and compliance-related information. Continues to develop knowledge of IT controls, SOX requirements, cybersecurity, business processes, emerging technologies, and industry practices. Contributes to team objectives and supports other compliance activities and improvement initiatives as required. Qualifications: Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity , or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in IT audit, Risk Management, SOX Compliance, ITGCs, technology risk, internal controls, or related fields. Previous experience with a Big 4 or similar audit/consulting environment is preferred but not mandatory . Working knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements and IT control concepts. Good understanding of IT General Controls , including: Logical access Change management Computer operations System development/change lifecycle Hands-on experience with SAP ITGC/SOX testing is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of SAP GRC and SAP Security , including access provisioning, User Access Reviews (UAR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), Firefighter/Emergency Access, and privileged access controls. Understanding of SAP change management and transport controls , including approvals, testing, production changes, and segregation of duties. Basic to intermediate understanding of IT Automated Controls, application controls, and interfaces . Ability to understand business and IT environments through walkthroughs with application owners, control owners, and other stakeholders. Ability to identify key risks and understand controls designed to mitigate those risks. Experience performing control testing, reviewing supporting evidence, documenting test procedures, and identifying exceptions. Familiarity with business processes such as Finance, IT, HR, Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting is preferred. Exposure to enterprise applications such as ServiceNow, Oracle, Salesforce , or similar platforms is an advantage. Professional certifications such as CISA, CPA, CISSP, CRISC , or similar certifications are preferred or may be pursued as part of professional development. Skills and Competencies Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to execute assigned compliance activities independently while seeking guidance for complex or judgmental matters. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with IT, business teams, control owners, and auditors. Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established timelines. Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills. Proactive and willing to learn new technologies, business processes, and compliance requirements. Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio . Experience analyzing data using Excel or other analytics tools is an advantage. Ability to work independently on assigned activities and collaboratively as part of the broader IT Compliance team.

title: Software Development Engineer - Agentic Data Infrastructure, Partner Data And Analytics
description: DESCRIPTION The Data Services team within PDNA (Partner Data And Analytics) builds and operates the Agentic Data Platform that powers Amazon's Selling Partner analytics infrastructure. We serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians through 4,000+ standardized metrics, real-time streaming pipelines validated at Black Friday scale (142M+ events), and the Curated Data Layer (CDL) — Amazon's strategic data infrastructure for Selling Partner GenAI applications including Seller Assistant, Supply Chain Expert, MCF, and ISS. We are building the future where intelligent agents autonomously operate data pipelines, serve analytics through MCP servers, and enable self-service insights at scale. You will build the infrastructure layer that sits between raw data and intelligent agents. Think of it as the operating system for agentic data — the MCP servers agents call, the query engines they reason through, the schema contracts they interpret, the streaming backbone they react to, and the validation services they trust. This is systems engineering applied to the agentic AI problem: you are not building agents — you are building the infrastructure that makes agents possible. Key job responsibilities 1) Design and build MCP servers and data access APIs 2) Engineer the real-time streaming backbone using Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka/MSK, Kinesis, and Lambda that powers agentic workflows. 3) Build agent orchestration infrastructure — the tool registries, execution planners, state stores, and handoff protocols that enable specialized agents (ingestion, validation, delivery) to coordinate across the data operations lifecycle. 4) Develop trust and validation infrastructure that keeps agent-generated outputs reliable 5) Extend the lakehouse for agentic consumption — building metadata contracts, schema registries, and catalog APIs on top of our Iceberg-based infrastructure that agents can reason over autonomously. 6) Own your systems end-to-end — design, build, test, deploy, operate, and document. Your infrastructure will be observable, self-healing, and resilient. You will participate in on-call, drive root-cause analysis, and permanently resolve operational issues. 7) BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience Proficiency in one or more systems languages (Java, Python, Kotlin, TypeScript, Scala, or Rust) Experience designing and operating production services — API design, distributed system patterns (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance), and service-oriented architectures Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and system design Experience with data infrastructure — lakehouse architectures (Iceberg), query engines (Athena, Trino), or metadata/catalog systems PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with agentic AI infrastructure — tool registries, agent orchestration, LLM integration, or agent state management Familiarity with GenAI infrastructure patterns (RAG, embedding stores, evaluation frameworks) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Data Engineer, Agentic Data Platform, Partner Data And Analytics
description: DESCRIPTION We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Agentic Data Platform team and help build the next generation of Amazon's Partner analytics infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of large-scale data engineering and agentic AI — designing systems that power 4,000+ standardized metrics daily, serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians, and enable AI-driven automation across the Parter ecosystem of tools and products. Key job responsibilities 1) You will build the foundational data layer that agentic systems depend on — schema-aware, version-controlled, and optimized for programmatic access. 2) You will engineer event-driven pipelines (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, Kinesis) that serve as the nervous system for agentic workflows — providing the low-latency data feeds that agents consume to trigger actions, detect anomalies, and orchestrate downstream processes. 3) You will define how agents discover data, resolve ambiguity across metric definitions, and compose multi-step analytical queries against our Curated Data Layer (CDL). 4) You will build intelligent agents that own the full DataOps loop: auto-detecting schema drift, self-healing broken pipelines, orchestrating metric onboarding workflows, running data quality checks, and publishing validated datasets — all with minimal human intervention. 5) You will design the trust layer for agentic data systems: output validation agents that verify SQL correctness before execution, confidence scoring for AI-generated metric definitions, automated regression testing against known-good baselines, and escalation workflows that route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers. 6) You will lead the transformation from static, manually-maintained pipelines to agent-operated infrastructure — migrating legacy ETL to Iceberg-based incremental processing, unifying metric definitions across 12+ surfaces through agent-driven reconciliation, and building the operational backbone that enables 4,000+ metrics to be governed, published, and consumed by both humans and AI agents. description: DESCRIPTION We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Agentic Data Platform team and help build the next generation of Amazon's Partner analytics infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of large-scale data engineering and agentic AI — designing systems that power 4,000+ standardized metrics daily, serve 900K+ Selling Partners and 30K+ Amazonians, and enable AI-driven automation across the Parter ecosystem of tools and products. Key job responsibilities 1) You will build the foundational data layer that agentic systems depend on — schema-aware, version-controlled, and optimized for programmatic access. 2) You will engineer event-driven pipelines (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, Kinesis) that serve as the nervous system for agentic workflows — providing the low-latency data feeds that agents consume to trigger actions, detect anomalies, and orchestrate downstream processes. 3) You will define how agents discover data, resolve ambiguity across metric definitions, and compose multi-step analytical queries against our Curated Data Layer (CDL). 4) You will build intelligent agents that own the full DataOps loop: auto-detecting schema drift, self-healing broken pipelines, orchestrating metric onboarding workflows, running data quality checks, and publishing validated datasets — all with minimal human intervention. 5) You will design the trust layer for agentic data systems: output validation agents that verify SQL correctness before execution, confidence scoring for AI-generated metric definitions, automated regression testing against known-good baselines, and escalation workflows that route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers. 6) You will lead the transformation from static, manually-maintained pipelines to agent-operated infrastructure — migrating legacy ETL to Iceberg-based incremental processing, unifying metric definitions across 12+ surfaces through agent-driven reconciliation, and building the operational backbone that enables 4,000+ metrics to be governed, published, and consumed by both humans and AI agents. title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description: Job Summary The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders. The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting. 2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records. 3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified. 4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets. 5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes. 6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis. 7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures. 8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries. 9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Education Required • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration. • Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred). • Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets). • Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage. • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification. • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines. Professional Certifications Required • N\A. (CIPM or CFA progress preferred) Years of experience are required. • Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in performance measurement, investment reporting, or fund operations at a bank, asset manager, fund administrator, or family office.
